attackers_goals: An attacker may extract plaintext credentials of the Network Access Account (NAA) from an SCCM environment to access resources and lateral movement within the network.
description: Possible user attempt to deobfuscate Network Access Account (NAA) credentials in Microsoft Configuration Manager. This may indicate a compromised account.
investigative_actions: Verify the activity with the performing user. Review related logs (e.g., Active Directory, SCCM logs) to identify the source of the modification and associated accounts. Look for unusual logins using the Network Access Account (NAA), on systems or at times that deviate from normal patterns. Looking for signs of credential extraction, such as tools or scripts.
